name: tiles-retest
stage: confirmatory re-test of one failed table (owner decision)
decision: Jerry 2026-11-08, after the tiles held-out FAIL (JSettlers paired +.053, LCB -.005 at alpha .05/4; board comment 6726762818): 'yea help do that' to re-testing on fresh seeds with more games.

first_attempt.note: The first attempt's FAIL stays recorded and is reported next to this re-test.

tables.jsettlers: experiments/jsettlers-retest-tiles.json and experiments/jsettlers-retest-served.json (Mac mini): the same 2048 seeded all-SMART JSettlers games per policy

scope: Only the failed JSettlers table is re-run. The internal tables passed on fresh held-out seeds in the first attempt and are not re-run; their result carries over unchanged.
gate: PASS iff the paired JSettlers table passes: per-game difference won(tiles) - won(served) over the 2048 games paired by game name, after scripts/jsettlers_paired.py confirms compatible receipts (same base seed, patch, all_smart, game set) and identical setup per game; mean difference >= 0 and one-sided paired-normal LCB > 0 at alpha .05/4 = .0125 (the first attempt's per-table level, kept, not loosened); both runs 0 bridge errors, 0 truncations, all 2048 games completed; more than 5% of games excluded fails the table.

power.note: Alternative +.045: the internal held-out Tactical lift (+.046), below the first attempt's JSettlers point (+.053) to avoid planning on a possibly inflated estimate. Sigma .586: per-game paired SD measured in the first attempt. Pass requires a mean above ~+.029 (2.241 x .586/sqrt(2048)). 1024 games would give power .585 at +.045 and was rejected as underpowered.

multiplicity: This is a second test of the same hypothesis after a failure. The per-table alpha stays at .0125 and both attempts are reported; a PASS here supports the promotion with that history stated, it does not erase the first FAIL.
consequence: PASS: the owner promotion is supported (internal held-out PASS + JSettlers re-test PASS); serving PR #45 can be updated with both results for Jerry's merge decision. FAIL: no further re-test of this table on this model; planner_offer_accept stays served.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any re-test game; fresh base seed 20261114.
